event.location_text: 新加坡海峡（新加坡水域）

sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Four unauthorised persons boarded the tanker underway and entered the engine room. The 2/E retreated to a safe location and immediately informed the Bridge. Alarm raised, crew mustered, and a search was conducted. The incident was reported to local authorities. Singapore Police Coast Guard boarded the tanker for investigation.
